# EnterpriseEventBase.Id property

Gets a unique identifier for this enterprise event.

```csharp
public Guid Id { get; set; }
```

## Remarks

In principle, an enterprise event (or any other notice) is a data transfer object; it has no identity. However, in practice, enterprise systems often need to identify specific event instances, e.g., for deduplication purposes.
